01.b: A mailman faces off with a loose Doberman Pinscher. Two Company agents confront Echo, and Echo flees after using his ability. One of the agents then decides to handle matters in his own way.

02.b: Echo returns home to flee with his girlfriend. The Constrictor arrives before they can leave, and Echo faces off with him. Echo and Gina receive yet another house guest.

03.b: As someone knocks at the door, Echo gets Gina to flee. Echo confronts two more Company agents. Echo, bound and gagged in a Company cell, has a not-so-mysterious visitor.

04.b: Santiago discovers he has a special ability. After attending mass, he meets a young woman on the way to a soccer game.

05.b: The score becomes tied at the end of the soccer match, and Esteban gives Santiago a pep talk. Santiago scores the winning goal, and gives the money he wins to Elisa. Elisa tries to subdue Santiago, and gets a helping hand.

06.b: Elisa gets some advice on handling Santiago. Santiago awakens in a strange and secure place. After learning the nature of his ability, Santiago's captors force him into accepting a deadly mission. Santiago gets some help from an unlikely source.

07.b: Santiago and Elisa make a daring escape. Returning to his mother, Santiago learns the secrets run deeper than he thought. The serious looking woman is paid a surprise visit while orchestrating a clean-up.

08.b: Pinehearst recruit Rachel Mills is interrogated by Angela Petrelli. Rachel relives an explosive experience that occurred at Pinehearst a dozen hours earlier.

09.b: Rachel is interrogated by Carlos, who works for Angela, about the missing serum. Rachel has a flashback of the building collapse, when she injected David Sullivan with the serum.

10.b: Matt Parkman persuades Knox to abandon gang life. Knox tries to distance himself from his gang, but the gang's oppressive leader says otherwise. While in a fearful situation, Knox discovers his ability.

10-11.b: Matt Parkman persuades Knox to abandon gang life. Knox tries to distance himself from his gang, but the gang's oppressive leader says otherwise. While in a fearful situation, Knox discovers his ability. While trying to test out his newfound ability, Knox is confronted by Matt.

11.b: While trying to test out his newfound ability, Knox is confronted by Matt. Matt and Knox argue about getting out of gang life, only for Knox's gang to watch from a distance.

12.b: Angela continues to question Rachel about what happened. Rachel continues to recall what happened next at Pinehearst, but Angela does not believe her. Rachel informs Angela that she destroyed the serum, but then has a flashback of not destroying it.
12.sub: We Do What We Have to Do

13.b: Bartell confronts Knox about talking to the cops. Knox harnesses his new ability and defends himself.

13-14.b: Bartell confronts Knox about talking to the cops. Knox harnesses his new ability and defends himself. Matt Parkman directs traffic around the scene of an accident. Knox rides by and thanks Matt for his advice.

14.b: Matt Parkman directs traffic around the scene of an accident. Knox rides by and thanks Matt for his advice.

15.b: While Carlos stands guard, Angela continues to question Rachel. Angela asks about Rachel's mother's death and where Rachel was found after the Pinehearst incident. Rachel relives escaping the Pinehearst lab, but denies she is special.

16.b: Angela releases Rachel, claiming to have given up. Rachel retrieves the serum from its hiding place, but Angela is waiting to take it from her. Angela contacts an old friend.

17.b: Doyle struggles with starting a new life. Doyle runs into trouble at work with his boss.

18.b: Doyle pleads for a statement of character from Kyle Dilman. In a moment of rage, Doyle's ability consumes him.

19.b: Lauren and Jason share a moment and a secret. Kyle fires "Jerry", who finds revenge.

20.b: Lauren and Jason discover that they both have something to celebrate. Kyle sends a surprising video to Lauren. Doyle doesn't let Barbie know about a dark secret.

21.b: Edgar retrieves a phone for Lydia. Lydia is concerned about her daughter. Caleb tells Samuel about Lydia and Edgar.

22.b: Samuel warns Edgar of his actions. Lydia makes contact with her daughter. Amanda explains her frustrations with her abilities.

23.b: Lydia reveals her gift to Amanda. Amanda leaves her home in flames. While attempting to help Lydia, Edgar is caught by Samuel.

24.b: Samuel confronts Lydia about her daughter. Lydia receives a visit from someone unexpected.

25.b: Lydia and Amanda discuss Amanda's presence at the carnival. Amanda shows Caleb what she can do.

26.b: Amanda yearns to learn more about the carnival. Edgar confronts Caleb. Samuel meets his newest "family" member.

27.b: Edgar and Lydia plot to take control. Samuel shows Amanda the carnival. Amanda shows Samuel her power.

28.b: Amanda officially joins the carnival, much to Lydia 's annoyance. Lydia and Edgar try to convince Samuel that the carnival isn't safe for Amanda.

29.b: Samuel talks to Lydia about Amanda 's place in the carnival. Amanda is physically abused by Caleb, and he pays the price.

30.b: Amanda recovers from Caleb 's death, with Lydia 's help. Samuel shows Lydia that Amanda is nicely settled at the carnival. Lydia receives a message from Edgar.

31.b: Hero Truther rallies the world's evos. Two years ago, Phoebe reveals her abilities to her brother Quentin.

32.b: Phoebe moves into college and begins to further develop her ability.

32-36.b: Phoebe moves into college and begins to further develop her ability. It is revealed that evos are being openly discriminated against, such as being denied scholarships. Evos are forced to register with the department of homeland security because of a federal mandate. . . Phoebe's fate is discovered.

33.b: It is revealed that evos are being openly discriminated against, such as being denied scholarships. Evos are forced to register with the department of homeland security because of a federal mandate.

36.b: Phoebe's fate is discovered. Hero Truther 's identity is revealed. Quentin begins a new journey.

37.b: Damen Peak conducts a meeting with Jim. Joanne Collins takes notes on her new target.

37-38.b: Damen Peak conducts a meeting with Jim. Joanne Collins takes notes on her new target. Joanne Collins hunts down a new target. Damen Peak uses his ability to get what he wants.

38.b: Joanne Collins hunts down a new target. Damen Peak uses his ability to get what he wants.

39.b: Joanne Collins finally catches up with her target.
